card.name: Numbers in citations and section numbers
card.fires_on: Digits or hyphens inside reference numbers and section numbers, often right after a sentence end, such as footnote marks, number ranges and headings like 7.6 or 2.2.

modes.label: Section numbers
modes.description: The first digit of a numbered section heading that follows a sentence end.
modes.example: clopidogrel inhibits CYP2C9. <<7>>.6 SSRIs and SNRIs

modes.label: Footnote or citation numbers
modes.description: A digit or hyphen in a superscript-style reference number or citation list.
modes.example: Several guidelines on this subject have been published. 1<<->>7 There is no general agreement
